data.name: The Loer Chronicles
data.detailed_description:
The Source Ring broke. Loer tore apart into floating isles, and the rifts it opened have been bleeding Essence Devourers ever since.

You are an Elementalist. You handle the movement — your five equipped element skills fire on their own. Everything between the first spawn and the Elemental Lord is a build decision made at speed.

THE WRONG ELEMENT DOESN'T UNDERPERFORM — IT HEALS THE ENEMY




Every hit is resolved against the Five Elements before anything else. Most pairings land as ordinary damage. The ten pairings on this wheel decide the fight:

  • Red arrows — Mutual Overcoming. The right element. Your damage is multiplied by roughly ×2 and lands with its own hit effect. Health bars fall off a cliff.
  • Green arrows — Mutual Generation. The wrong element. The target takes no damage at all. It recovers health instead, by roughly ×2 the hit you just landed — so the harder you hit, the faster it heals.

The whole system fits in five lines. Your element beats the first target and heals the second:

  • Wood overcomes Earth · feeds Fire
  • Fire overcomes Metal · feeds Earth
  • Earth overcomes Water · feeds Metal
  • Metal overcomes Wood · feeds Water
  • Water overcomes Fire · feeds Wood

This is what makes a loadout matter more than a damage stat. Take a Wood build into a Fire realm and you are not doing less damage — you are healing the Elemental Lord with every shot, for the whole fight. And it tightens as you climb: on higher difficulties the Overcoming bonus shrinks while the healing penalty grows.

Realm intel shows the Elemental Lord's element and the three skills it runs all fight before you commit. Bringing the wrong five into a run is a decision you made, not an accident.

CHAINS WANT BREADTH. MASTERIES WANT DEPTH.


Every level-up deals you three cards. What's in the deck:

  • 35 element skills — projectiles, beams, orbitals, summons, auras and ground traps. You take five into a run.
  • 35 chain skills — invest across a generation pair (Wood→Fire, Fire→Earth, Earth→Metal, Metal→Water, Water→Wood) and an extra skill starts casting itself for free. All five pairs can run at once.
  • 60 masteries — push one element down one branch far enough and it forks: A or B, then C or D. These rewrite how an element behaves, not just its numbers.
  • 96 relics — common through epic, pulled out of realm ruins mid-run.

A single run is never long enough for both. Spreading wide lights up chains early; committing hard gets you the mastery that defines the run. You make that call with the horde already on screen.

FIVE ELEMENTALISTS, FIVE DIFFERENT PROBLEMS


Every hero has a home element, a talent that shoves you toward one playstyle, and a cost you will feel:

  • Vel · Verdant Warden (Wood) — Forest Symbiosis. Summons hit harder and turn their own damage into your shield; below 25% HP you start regenerating. Everything that isn't Wood lands softer.
  • Brock · Lava Smith (Fire) — Forge Heart. Kills stack damage. Go eight seconds untouched and you Quench for more damage and attack speed; take one hit and you Overheat. Water damage hurts him 30% more.
  • Golen · Royal Knight (Earth) — Bedrock Bulwark. Every hit taken stacks damage reduction, up to 45%. He gets tougher the deeper you stand in the swarm. He also never dodges — ever — and heals 40% worse.
  • Zero · Void Walker (Metal) — Void Step. A successful dodge guarantees a crit that ignores half of armor, and Metal attacks execute non-boss enemies outright below 15% HP. Paper health. No margin for error.
  • Celeste · Twilight Stargazer (Water) — Starlight Guidance. Anything slowed, chilled, frozen or rooted takes +25% crit chance and +35% crit damage from every element you own. Freeze first, delete second. Extremely fragile.

Hero levels raise the talent passive with no ceiling and unlock four advanced talent skills per hero at Lv.4 / 7 / 10 / 13 — twenty more auto-casting skills that never take up one of your five slots.

15 REALMS. 15 ELEMENTAL LORDS.


  • Stage runs — pick a realm and one of three difficulties, clear the kill quota, then put the Elemental Lord down inside 120 seconds. This is where element skills and armor drop.
  • Reincarnation Realm — one entrance, no exit. Beat the boss and the world rotates to another realm; the tide compounds in power every minute you stay alive. Leaderboards settle daily and weekly on kills.
  • Realm ruins — timed elemental hazard fields that open mid-run in both modes. Hold the ground and it pays out; clear one on a stage run and it drops a relic chest.

BUILD BETWEEN RUNS


  • Gear with instances and affixes — element skills and armor drop with quality tiers and rolled affixes. Enhance them at the Blacksmith, salvage the rest into enchanting materials, forge what you're missing.
  • Player Marketplace — list your spare instances, buy the piece your build has been waiting on, settle through the in-game mail.
  • Hero Cards — dropped by minions, elites and bosses; spend them to unlock heroes and push hero levels.
  • Milestones — lifetime kills, survival time, damage, realm hazard clears and more, across 46 claimable tiers.
  • Friends — deploy a friend's hero as an AI companion that fights alongside you for the whole run.

FREE TO PLAY, STATED UP FRONT


  • No ads on PC. The desktop build ships without an ad SDK at all.
  • No energy system and no run limits. Play as long as you want.
  • No paywalled power. The shop sells crystals, gift bundles and an optional 30-day pass — no exclusive skills, no exclusive damage multipliers, no strength-gated tickets. Everything on sale can also be earned in-game.
  • A free daily gift of 600 crystals on every platform.
  • One account across PC, mobile and web, with cloud saves.

Loer is still in pieces. Go pick some of them up.

data.short_description: Hit with the right element and your damage doubles. Hit with the wrong one and the enemy heals instead. A horde-survival roguelike where you only steer: five element skills auto-cast, chains and masteries rebuild every run, and 15 realms each hide an Elemental Lord.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Indonesian, Turkish, Japanese, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Vietnamese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent, Dual Core 2.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Requires Steam client. Internet connection required for login, cloud save, downloads, and online features.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Stable broadband recommended for marketplace and cloud sync.
